\[
\text{cw: } I'(x, y) = I(y,\, H - 1 - x),\qquad \text{horizontal: } I'(x, y) = I(W - 1 - x,\, y)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(W, H\): The width and height of the input
- \(I'\): The output image

W and H are the width and height of the input. A clockwise quarter turn makes an image H pixels wide and W high. Its pixel x, y comes from column y and row H - 1 - x of the input. A horizontal flip takes column W - 1 - x. The other turns and the vertical flip follow the same pattern.
